summary: Unconditional thiscall constructor. Calls VtableSetWithInitCall with two raw literal arguments (1163575296, 1177792512, the bit patterns of a large float range), installs the vtable off_5A5710 at +0x0, sets the enable/active flag byte at +0xF0 to 1, and returns this. No guards; straight-line initialization.

operations.description: Invoke VtableSetWithInitCall(this, 1163575296, 1177792512) to initialize the object's range fields from the two literal arguments.
Install the type vtable by writing the address of off_5A5710 into the vtable pointer at this+0x0.
Set the flag/enable byte at this+0xF0 to 1 (active).
Return the this pointer as the constructor result.
